items.title: ‘You Don’t Want Rogue Agents’: Jamie Dimon Shuts Meta’s Muse AI Agent Out of JPMorgan. What It Means for META Stock. - Barchart.com
items.zh_title: “你不想要失控的智能体”：摩根大通 CEO 杰米·戴蒙把 Meta 的 Muse AI 智能体挡在门外，这对 META 股价意味着什么
items.zh_oneliner: 摩根大通 CEO 杰米·戴蒙以“不想要失控的智能体”为由，禁止在行内使用 Meta 的 Muse AI 智能体，文章分析了这一决定对 META 股价的影响。
items.en_oneliner: JPMorgan CEO Jamie Dimon has barred Meta's Muse AI agent inside the bank, saying "you don't want rogue agents," and the article examines what the move means for META stock.
